Built 1871[1]

Harbor Point Lighthouse is a lighthouse on the northern breakwater of Port Example. It was completed in 1871 and first lit on 1 May of that year.[1] The tower is 24 metres tall.[2]

History

Construction was approved by the U.S. Lighthouse Board in 1868. Work began the following spring. Dr. A. Smith, the board's engineer, designed the lantern room.[3][a] The light was automated in 1965,[1] and the keeper's house became a museum.[citation needed]

  • The original Fresnel lens is on display in the museum.[4]
